requirements.statement: Architecture Evaluation consumes the canonical CCG Module and dependency facts to derive architecture and physical ownership views without owning or rebuilding contract resolution.
The ARCH-DEPENDENCY-001 evaluator deterministically reports cycles in the Module graph derived from required capabilities.

ARCH-REALIZATION-001 deterministically reconciles independently observed direct Rust Module dependencies with CCG direct authorization, hard-fails undeclared and transitive-bypass access, and keeps declared-unobserved, external, unresolved, unsupported, and capability-realization states truthful.

Architecture Evaluation deterministically derives non-normative architecture diagnostics from canonical CCG containment and dependency facts plus independently observed realization while separating evidence-backed structural opportunities from rule violations.

Behavioral Realization validates canonical distributed opt-in authority that completely binds every Intended BFG checkpoint to exact alternative symbol, state, effect, information-flow, or environmental semantic anchors owned within the Feature scope.

Behavioral Realization derives a deterministic language-neutral implementation-event model and coverage-aware checkpoint reachability exclusively from canonical program, value, state/effect, information-flow, and environmental semantics without reparsing source.

Behavioral Realization projects next semantic checkpoint transitions, reconciles intended edges, decisions and terminals, and rejects only supported undeclared transitions, impossible intent, or exact Intended BFG dominator bypasses while preserving uncertainty.

Behavioral Realization emits canonical Realized BFG v1 derived information with complete upstream digests, derivation evidence, explicit coverage and unsupported semantics, plus deterministic verification obligations that never imply executed evidence.

Behavioral Semantics deterministically compiles CCG-preserved distributed checkpoints into canonical Intended BFG v1 Feature flows with Module participation, boundary crossings, reachability, SCC, dominator, post-dominator, provenance, and explicit unsupported-semantics facts.

BEHAVIOR-FLOW-001 rejects implemented graph contradictions in modeled Features while preserving legal terminal-reaching loops and representing unmodeled Features explicitly without treating them as passing modeled flows.
Fortress records its current declared model and accurately reports that it is not certified.

Fortress deterministically compiles its complete live Module Contract v2 ecosystem into the canonical provenance-preserving CCG with unique identities, compatible capabilities, effective constraints, verification topology, exact input digests, and explicit unsupported semantics.
The compiler loads canonical Module Contract v2 and recursively discovered containment into one schema-versioned CCG containing every supported semantic domain with precise source provenance.

The CCG deterministically derives dependency reachability, inverse consumers, inherited and implied constraints, conflict failures, guarantee support, and parent-local verification topology without implicit capability re-export or unsupported proof claims.
Canonical CCG serialization is UTF-8, LF-terminated, deterministically ordered, content-addressed outside its own bytes, repeatable, and equal to Fortress's committed self-CCG Info artifact.

Environmental Semantics validates canonical Module-local Environment Contracts, exact governed boundary symbols, generic nondeterministic outcome dimensions, existing value/state/flow vocabularies, and complete provenance without provider-specific inference.

Environmental Semantics evaluates every admissible outcome independently, proves supported continuations, preserves completion uncertainty, and rejects incompatible retries, unstable idempotency identities, or duplicate-unsafe delivery.

Environmental Semantics checks bounded interruption and recovery obligations at declared durable effect steps, distinguishes trusted atomicity from proved internal facts, and derives deterministic failure-test obligations for every modeled outcome.

Environmental Semantics emits deterministic summaries, normalized rule findings, explicit property coverage, canonical derived information, and fault scenarios bound to all upstream semantic identities.

The complete Fortress repository audit is modeled as one coherent deterministic intended Feature flow at the root Module scope spanning CLI request interpretation, repository stabilization, CCG compilation, implementation observation, architecture and rule evaluation, and truthful PASS or FAIL classification.

Implementation observation verifies exact snapshot-bound source bytes and deterministically emits language-neutral Rust dependency facts, explicit analyzer coverage, and normalized Module edges without consulting declared dependency intent.

Rust analyzer v1 structurally resolves Cargo targets, module declarations, use and qualified paths, same-crate ownership, workspace facades, and external or unresolved references with deterministic provenance while leaving capability realization unsupported.
Information Flow validates one canonical project-defined finite facet policy and resolves every Function Contract flow declaration against it without hard-coded project labels.
Information Flow conservatively propagates classifications through supported PSM value, call, wrapper, product, field, and mutation topology while preserving source and derivation provenance.

Information Flow rejects supported source-to-sink contradictions, never changes classification implicitly, and exposes every explicit endorsement or declassification as a provenance-preserving trusted boundary.
Information Flow emits deterministic summaries, findings, trusted-transition diagnostics, explicit coverage states, and a canonical derived artifact bound to all semantic inputs.
Program Semantics deterministically derives snapshot-bound Rust executable symbols and language-neutral typed interfaces with exact physical Fortress Module ownership and explicit semantic coverage.

Program Semantics conservatively resolves supported direct Rust calls, preserves every coverage state, and derives deterministic direct, transitive, recursive, cross-Module, and cross-package call topology without converting reachability into intent.

Program Semantic analysis records bounded value-transfer facts, remains byte deterministic, rejects snapshot mutation, distinguishes production from Testing symbols, and requires every resolved cross-Module call to agree with broader Implementation Observation evidence.

Program Semantics translates supported Rust bodies into deterministic language-neutral statement, expression, pattern, branch, loop, return, and exceptional facts so downstream semantic reasoning consumes the PSM rather than reparsing source.

Program Semantics deterministically indexes locally governed Rust structs, enums, traits, type aliases, fields, variants, and inherent or trait implementation blocks without changing executable symbol identities merely because the PSM schema evolves.

Program Semantics propagates supported local static expression types to resolve inherent and concrete trait method calls conservatively, emits canonical interprocedural transfers for newly resolved calls, and assigns stable semantic reasons to every residual non-static call.

Program Semantics v3 emits deterministic structured binding, field, tuple-field, and dereference places plus direct state-read and mutation facts with exact resolution and provenance, without interpreting mutation safety.
The core loads schema-versioned operational project configuration and rejects invalid, duplicate, or unsafe repository observation exclusions.
The temporal change schema represents ordinary changes without requiring bootstrap-only packet provenance.
Repository observation emits deterministic sorted repository-relative file facts with byte size and SHA-256 content identity.
Observation rejects unsafe exclusion paths and applies explicit exclusions without converting observations into declarations.

Semantic Analysis validates canonical distributed Function Contract v3 value-domain authority against exact PSM symbol ownership, static interfaces, and deterministic semantic value domains while leaving state/effect and information-flow obligations to their owning analyzers.

Semantic Analysis conservatively refines supported control flow and propagates argument, parameter, return, assignment, wrapper, product, and recursive domains to a deterministic widened fixed point without narrowing a callee from current callers.

Semantic Analysis checks supported call preconditions, proves authored postconditions, detects understood partial-operation and impossible-state contradictions with abstract counter-domains, and preserves granular uncertainty rather than treating unsupported semantics as safe.

Semantic Analysis emits deterministic canonical summaries and derived Info bound to the PSM and Function Contract digests, and PROGRAM-DOMAIN-001 converts only supported contradictions into normalized findings.

A canonical repository snapshot deterministically binds the exact declared standard/project inputs, explicit observation policy, stable observed file inventory, engine interpretation version, and content fingerprints without wall-clock identity.
Snapshot creation rejects a repository whose included path set, byte sizes, or content digests change between two canonical observation passes.
Snapshot rule violations use one validated content-addressed finding contract and a deterministic global sort order.
The Snapshot Governance engine validates the exact standard bundle, executes only registered applicable evaluators, and distinguishes evaluated pass/fail results from unsupported rules.

ARCH-OWNERSHIP-001 deterministically assigns every governed observed file to exactly one physical Module territory and reports orphan, incompatible overlap, or missing explicit fixture claims while respecting observation exclusions.

TEST-TRACEABILITY-001 loads distributed requirement ownership, extracts deterministic snapshot-bound Rust test facts, and rejects missing, orphaned, stale, duplicate, cross-boundary, marker-mismatched, or infrastructure-counted evidence.

A repository audit loads the exact declared inputs, builds a stabilized content-addressed snapshot, requires loaded declaration bytes to match it, analyzes supported Rust test facts, and deterministically evaluates every implemented applicable snapshot rule without claiming certification.

REPO-MODULE-001 defines and deterministically evaluates the canonical recursive Module grammar, including root surfaces, mandatory README.md and contract.json, code/mods obligations, attribute flatness, bidirectional code/data/info/mods documentation presence, and filesystem naming.

REPO-DOCS-001 parses canonical Module Markdown structurally, validates typed Module contracts, and deterministically reconciles filesystem catalogs, child catalogs, relationship projections, and relative links without treating unsupported source-dependency inference as evaluated.

CONTRACT-COHERENCY-001 passes only when canonical CCG compilation succeeds, its supported semantic graph is coherent, provenance is complete, and README relationship projection agrees while explicitly unsupported semantic classes remain non-evidence.

TEST-BOUNDARY-001 deterministically enforces recursive parent-local Feature verification through exact Testing-child presence, Feature subjects, role restrictions, source placement, and ownership-aware requirement evidence without introducing unit, integration, or end-to-end filesystem taxonomies.

A complete snapshot audit compiles Intended BFG semantics once from the same immutable CCG, evaluates BEHAVIOR-FLOW-001 without rebuilding graphs per rule, and leaves unmodeled Features explicit and non-failing.
The core validates canonical stable Fortress entity and rule identities under STD-ID-001.
The draft registry exposes unique valid rule metadata without claiming a released edition.
Every registered schema and draft standard record parses, has unique identity, and agrees with the implemented registry.

The selected standard validates canonical rule implication and conflict metadata, permits satisfiable implication cycles, and rejects unknown, self-conflicting, or inherently unsatisfiable rule logic.

State and Effect Analysis validates canonical distributed State Contract v1 and Function Contract v3 state/effect authority against PSM nominal ownership, fields, symbols, and Semantic Analysis domains.

State and Effect Analysis conservatively classifies exact, possible, unclassified, and unknown typestates and composes supported receiver transitions through resolved calls without treating opaque aliases as unchanged.

State and Effect Analysis derives direct and SCC-aware transitive effects with causal provenance and rejects only supported state precondition, state postcondition, and authored effect-policy contradictions.
State and Effect Analysis emits deterministic canonical derived Info and PROGRAM-STATE-001 and PROGRAM-EFFECT-001 findings while preserving property-specific coverage and unsupported semantics.
The core command registry exposes only unique, stable, implemented command contracts.
CLI dispatch renders discovery and returns non-success for unsupported commands.
The native process implements version and help entrypoints with stable failure semantics.

The native fortress audit command accepts an optional repository root, renders deterministic human or schema-versioned JSON output, succeeds only without evaluated violations, and rejects malformed project state or unsupported options.

The native fortress ccg command compiles the canonical repository semantic IR once, renders deterministic canonical JSON, returns non-success for incoherency or invalid state, and rejects unsupported formats without implying certification.

The native fortress bfg command compiles Intended BFG v1 from the repository CCG, emits canonical deterministic JSON to standard output or an explicit file, returns non-success for incoherent modeled flow or invalid state, and never implies behavior realization or certification.

The native fortress psm command compiles snapshot-bound Program Semantic Model v3, emits canonical deterministic JSON to standard output or an explicit file, returns non-success for invalid or analyzer-incoherent state, and never implies behavioral realization or certification.

The native fortress semantic command compiles PSM-backed Function Contract and abstract-domain analysis, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or an explicit file, fails on supported contradictions or invalid state, and preserves uncertainty without implying total program safety or certification.

The native fortress state-effect command compiles PSM- and Semantic-Analysis-backed typestate and effect analysis, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves uncertainty without implying total program safety or certification.

The native fortress information-flow command compiles one PSM-, Semantic-, and State/Effect-backed information-flow model, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported sink contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves security uncertainty without implying comprehensive security proof or certification.

The native fortress environmental command compiles one PSM-, value-, state/effect-, and information-flow-backed environmental model, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported environment/retry/recovery contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves uncertainty without implying comprehensive fault-tolerance proof or certification.

The native fortress realized-bfg command compiles one Intended-BFG- and implementation-semantics-backed Realized BFG, emits deterministic canonical JSON to standard output or a file, fails on supported realization or bypass contradictions or invalid authority, and preserves coverage uncertainty without implying runtime trace evidence or certification.
